subject.title: Discord account-to-agent routing falls back to default agent instead of matching by account name

question: Should unmatched non-default Discord account ids implicitly route to same-named configured agents, fail closed, or remain explicit-binding-only with stronger setup/doctor diagnostics?
rationale: The current documented contract uses explicit bindings, but the reported default fallback can cross agent permission boundaries; changing it is both compatibility-sensitive and security-sensitive.

options.title: Guarded same-name fallback
options.body: Route non-default Discord accounts to an existing same-named agent only after explicit binding tiers miss, keeping the `default` account on the existing default-agent path and adding tests/docs.

options.title: Explicit bindings plus diagnostics
options.body: Keep runtime routing unchanged but add setup/doctor warnings or repairs so named Discord accounts without bindings are visible before they route to default.

options.title: Fail closed for unmatched named accounts
options.body: Reject or drop unmatched named Discord account traffic until an explicit binding exists, maximizing safety at the cost of upgrade compatibility.

recommendation.title: Guarded same-name fallback
recommendation.body: Route non-default Discord accounts to an existing same-named agent only after explicit binding tiers miss, keeping the `default` account on the existing default-agent path and adding tests/docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans routing policy and security-sensitive fallback behavior, and steipete has the strongest central routing history in the sampled commits.
